quantities: x and y: first-hour labour on A and B in person-hours.
x+y: combined first-hour labour; panel-(b) rows are categorical, not a vertical quantity.

initial_reconstruction.evidence_status: The caption identifies a constructed example and an unobserved, nonunique schedule. No probability or estimated confidence is shown.
initial_reconstruction.scope: One person, two tasks totalling one person-hour each in two hours. The shown schedule witnesses only P; its arbitrary task switching is permitted by the model.
unintended_inferences: The shaded square can initially suggest joint feasibility, but its exclusion labels and the caption identify it as the separate-bound set.
The single P witness does not prove the whole diagonal is attainable, identify the true history, or establish zero switching costs in real work.
The original subject “schedule permits interruption” was slightly imprecise; the revised caption makes switching a permission in the constructed example.
